gate_changes_reviewed.change: Control accepted a bounded generic artifact-to-handoff machine-binding guard prototype
Suppression Architecture exposed a decision-relevant machine-fact extraction false negative despite correct provenance binding
MAIN failed closed after the post-outcome diagnostic anomaly and refused same-run repair/rerun/rescore/relabel
Evidence Analyst promoted cross-cascade fallback only as Architecture/testbed segmentation semantics after ordinary control-flow reduction

false_positive_risks: A provenance-correct artifact can still contain a semantically wrong decision-relevant extracted fact
Manual durable handoff transcription can still overstate support breadth or criterion satisfaction until the generic guard is demonstrated
Architecture/API findings could be laundered into mechanistic novelty if claim-type boundaries are ignored
Stronger-privilege ceilings could be mistaken for equal-resource mechanistic comparators
false_negative_risks: Brittle literal or syntax-specific detectors can produce false negatives for implementation properties that are actually present
Fail-closed handling would become overconservative if a detector mismatch automatically rejected the candidate rather than blocking only interpretation-dependent continuation
Universal replication or stronger novelty thresholds would suppress useful Architecture/testbed questions without addressing detector fidelity
Fitting a universal support threshold to completed Top-k outcomes would create post-outcome goalpost movement

notes: machine-fact semantic validation checks whether the artifact field itself represents the bound source/runtime condition
fresh Analyst review protects allocation after result interpretation

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: The suppression artifact and emitted AMBIGUOUS_CONTRACT token were not repaired or relabeled. MAIN/Evidence Analyst instead blocked successor use after detecting a diagnostic anomaly. New validation recommendations apply prospectively.

required_path: support or uncertainty adequate to the local question
matched equal-privilege comparators for mechanistic claims
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object. Handoff guard is only assigned as a prototype and suppression exposes a separate upstream extractor-validity gap.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature/audit calibrate reductions and claim boundaries; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: Highest-value methodology work is now validating the generic handoff guard and the suppression static-fact extractor. Additional scientific strictness would target the wrong failure mode and reduce lower-funnel information gain.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer funnel, strict FORMAL novelty bar, comparator discipline, ordinary-reduction-first interpretation, and hard integrity floor unchanged.
Complete and evaluate the bounded handoff-binding guard prototype without live scientific mutation.

Require prospectively specified validity checks for decision-relevant machine facts derived from source/runtime inspection; prefer structural/AST/typed checks or explicit invariant tests over brittle literal substring matching when practical.

On post-outcome detector mismatch, preserve the artifact and block interpretation-dependent continuation; require fresh prospective authority for any new diagnostic object and never silently repair/reinterpret the completed attempt.
Do not introduce universal replication, threshold inflation, or automatic candidate rejection in response to detector-fidelity defects.
Keep local Architecture terminal classes and detector checks separate from FORMAL and new-principle novelty thresholds.
Do not retroactively rescore, relabel, rerun, invalidate, or upgrade consumed/frozen experiments because of methodology recommendations.
questions_for_control_brain: Will the handoff-binding prototype remain distinct from semantic machine-fact extractor validation rather than being treated as sufficient by itself?
Will Control disposition the suppression static-detector consistency request without authorizing same-object repair/rerun/rescore?
Can detector validation remain an integrity safeguard without inflating substantive novelty/replication thresholds?
questions_for_evidence_analyst: Will future Architecture contracts bind not only machine fields but also the validation method for decision-relevant source/runtime-derived facts?
Will source-semantic detectors avoid brittle literal matching where a structural/AST/typed invariant is available?
Will any future suppression successor be a fresh prospective object rather than a repaired reinterpretation of the completed attempt?
